Analyze 1 µL of each prepared library using Qubit™ dsDNA HS Assay Kit Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher . Using the quantifications for each library, pool libraries equally by mass (ng) in a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube . Vortex to mix and centrifuge briefly. Analyze 1 µL of the library pool using the Qubit™ dsDNA HS Assay Kit Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher . (If the concentration is too high, dilute it down to a suitable concentration for TapeStation and qPCR) Run 1 µL of the library pool on a using the D1000 Screen Tape Agilent Technologies . The library pool is then quantified by qPCR using the Library Quantification Kit Takara Bio Catalog #Cat. No. 638319 . The molarity of the library pool is calculated using the average fragment size obtained from the TapeStation (expected ~350 bp). Using the quantification obtained from qPCR, the library pool is then normalized to a starting concentration ( 2-4 nanomolar (nM) ) using Resuspension Buffer Illumina . Follow the denature and dilute instructions for your chosen system to dilute to the final loading concentration. steps.title: Prepare Influenza primer pool
steps.instruction: Resuspend each desalted primer in 0.1× TE to a concentration of 100 µM, then combine the following volumes (µL) into a single pool: Uni12/Inf‑1 16.8, Uni12/Inf‑3 25.2, Uni13/Inf‑1 42, B‑PBs‑UniF 12, B‑PBs‑UniR 12, B‑PA‑UniF 5, B‑PA‑UniR 5, B‑HANA‑UniF 10, B‑HANA‑UniR 10, B‑NP‑UniF 8, B‑NP‑UniR 8, B‑M‑Uni3F 4, B‑Mg‑Uni3F 4, B‑M‑Uni3R 8, B‑NS‑Uni3F 6, B‑NS‑Uni3R 6. Dilute the combined pool with nuclease‑free water to a final working concentration of 10 µM for use in the one‑step RT‑PCR.

steps.title: Set up one‑step RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Thaw FSM, RVT, Flu AB Primer Pool, and IPM on ice, vortex each and keep on ice. Add 12 µL of the RT‑PCR master mix and 3 µL of RNA to each well of a new 96‑well PCR plate. Seal the plate, vortex at 1600 rpm for 1 min, centrifuge at 500 × g for 1 min, then run the Flu RT‑PCR program:

substeps.instruction: Preheat lid to 105 °C; reaction volume 15 µL.
Cycle 1: 42 °C for 60 min.
Cycle 2: 94 °C for 2 min.
Cycle 3: 94 °C for 20 s (5 cycles).
Cycle 4: 44 °C for 30 s.
Cycle 5: 68 °C for 3 min.
Cycle 6: 94 °C for 20 s (35 cycles).
Cycle 7: 58 °C for 30 s.
Cycle 8: 68 °C for 3 min.
Cycle 9: 68 °C for 5 min.
Hold at 4 °C.
Safe stopping point – seal plate and store at 2 °C–8 °C or leave on the thermal cycler overnight.

steps.title: Prepare tagmentation master mix
steps.instruction: In a microcentrifuge tube combine 2 µL EBLT, 6 µL TB1, and 10 µL NFW (total 18 µL) for each reaction. Add 15 µL of this mix to each well of a new PCR plate labelled TAG, then add 10 µL cDNA from the RT‑PCR plate. Seal, vortex at 1600 rpm for 1 min, centrifuge at 500 × g for 1 min, and run the iMAP_TAG program:

substeps.instruction: Preheat lid to 105 °C; reaction volume 25 µL.
Step 1: 55 °C for 5 min.
Step 2: 10 °C hold.

steps.title: Bind and neutralize tagmented DNA
steps.instruction: Immediately after the TAG program add 5 µL ST2 to each well. Seal, vortex at 1600 rpm for 1 min, centrifuge at 500 × g for 1 min, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, place on a magnetic stand for ~3 min until the liquid clears, then remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: TWB bead washes
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL TWB to each well, seal, vortex at 1600 rpm for 1 min, centrifuge at 500 × g for 1 min, place on a magnetic stand for ~2 min, then remove and discard the supernatant. Perform a second identical wash but **do not** remove the supernatant after the second wash to prevent bead overdrying.

steps.title: Bind beads to IPB and elute library
steps.instruction: Perform the following sequence to capture the tagmented DNA on Illumina Purification Beads (IPB) and elute the library:

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the TAG plate at 500 × g for 1 min.
Place the plate on a magnetic stand for ~3 min until clear.
Label a new PCR plate "IPB".
Vortex the IPB tube to resuspend beads and add 22.5 µL to each well of the IPB plate.
Transfer 25 µL supernatant from each TAG well to the corresponding IPB well.
Vortex briefly and centrifuge.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on magnetic stand for ~5 min, then discard the supernatant.
Add 100 µL 80 % EtOH to each well while on the magnetic stand, wait 30 s, discard supernatant (first wash).
Repeat the 80 % EtOH wash a second time.
Briefly centrifuge the plate to collect residual EtOH.
Place on magnetic stand until clear, then use a P20 pipette to remove **all** residual EtOH.
Air‑dry beads on the magnetic stand for 1 min.
Add 16 µL Resuspension Buffer (RSB) to each well, vortex, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Place on magnetic rack for ~3 min until clear.
Transfer 15 µL of the supernatant to a new PCR plate labelled "LIB".
Safe stopping point – seal the LIB plate and store at –25 °C to –15 °C.

steps.title: Prepare TAG PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Thaw EPM and Index Adapters, vortex, keep on ice. Add 20 µL EPM and 5 µL Index Adapter to each well of the TAG plate (which already contains the bound DNA). Seal, vortex at 1600 rpm for 1 min, centrifuge at 500 × g for 1 min, then run the TAG PCR program:

substeps.instruction: Preheat lid to 100 °C; reaction volume 25 µL.
Cycle 1: 72 °C for 3 min.
Cycle 2: 98 °C for 3 min.
Cycle 3: 98 °C for 20 s (7 cycles).
Cycle 4: 60 °C for 30 s.
Cycle 5: 72 °C for 1 min.
Cycle 6: 72 °C for 3 min.
Hold at 10 °C.
Adjust total PCR cycles according to cDNA input:
• 1–24 ng cDNA → 12 cycles
• 25–99 ng cDNA → 9 cycles
• 100–500 ng cDNA → 7 cycles

steps.title: Post‑TAG PCR bead cleanup
steps.instruction: After the TAG PCR, clean up the library with magnetic beads:

substeps.instruction: Place the PCR plate on a magnetic stand and discard the supernatant.
Add 100 µL 80 % EtOH to each well while on the magnetic stand, wait 30 s, discard supernatant (first wash).
Repeat the 80 % EtOH wash a second time.
Briefly centrifuge to collect residual EtOH, place on magnetic stand, and remove all residual EtOH with a P20 pipette.
Air‑dry beads for 1 min.
Add 16 µL RSB to each well, vortex, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Place on magnetic rack for ~3 min until clear.
Transfer 15 µL of the supernatant to a new PCR plate (final library).
Seal and store the library plate at –25 °C to –15 °C.

steps.title: Library quality control
steps.instruction: Assess each library and prepare the pooled sequencing input:

substeps.instruction: Analyse 1 µL of each library with a Qubit dsDNA HS Assay on a Qubit fluorometer.
Calculate library molarity assuming an average fragment size of 350 bp.
Dilute each library to a normalized concentration of 4 nM using RSB.
Pool 5 µL of each diluted library into a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Quantify the pooled library by qPCR using the Takara Library Quantification Kit.
Optional: run 1 µL of the pool on a TapeStation D1000 ScreenTape to verify average size.

steps.title: Dilute library for sequencing
steps.instruction: Using the qPCR concentration, dilute the pooled library to the starting concentration required for the chosen sequencing platform and then follow the manufacturer’s denature‑and‑dilute protocol to reach the final loading concentration:

substeps.instruction: NextSeq (Standard‑SBS): start 2 nM → final 2 pM loading.
NextSeq (XLEAP‑SBS): start 2 nM → final 2 pM loading.
MiSeq i100: start 2 nM → final 80 pM loading.
MiSeq V2: start 4 nM → final 10–12 pM loading.
MiSeq V3: start 4 nM → final 12–14 pM loading.

steps.title: Check subset of samples
steps.instruction: At least 10 % of the samples should be re‑checked after PCR using a Qubit Fluorometer and the Qubit DNA HS Assay to confirm successful amplification.
